problems: {"itemLocator":"sentences[1]","keyedAnswer":"I've had a sore throat for three days","kind":"twoDefensible","workedAnswer":"The keyed sentence is more idiomatic, but the tiles also allow “I've had a sore throat since three days ago.” Here “three days ago” is a starting point, so “since” is grammatical and the symptom duration is the same."}

{"itemLocator":"words[4]","keyedAnswer":"for three days = há três dias","kind":"twoDefensible","workedAnswer":"Without a sentence, “há três dias” can mean either “for three days” or the distractor “three days ago.” Compare “Estou com febre há três dias” (duration) with “A febre começou há três dias” (onset)."}
